components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Current desktop destinations with hover and active underlines.
components.html: 프로젝트개발 도구경력
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 26px; color: var(--color-ink, #181818); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; position: relative; min-height: 44px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.72; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 6px; inset-inline: 0; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #be3215); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 0; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 48px; font-size: 15px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav a::after { transition: none; } }

components.name: Project Work Index
components.description: A project destination with its approved responsibility label.
components.html: VuddyAndroid 앱 구조와 출시 후 운영
components.css: .ds-work { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; column-gap: 20px; min-height: 66px; padding: 15px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d0d0c8); color: var(--color-ink, #181818); text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-work-name { font-family: var(--font-exhibit, 'Uncut Sans', 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-work-note { grid-column: 1; margin-top: 5px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.72; color: var(--color-muted, #62625d); } .ds-work svg { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / 3; width: 24px; height: 24px; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-work:hover svg { transform: translateX(5px); } .ds-work:hover .ds-work-name { color: var(--color-accent, #c63819); } .ds-work:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #be3215); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-work { padding-block: 14px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-work svg { transition: none; } }

components.name: Media Selector
components.description: Actual feature labels with pressed-state ink and an underline.
components.css: .ds-media-selector { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-media-selector button { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted, #62625d); font-family: var(--font-exhibit, 'Uncut Sans', 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.72; cursor: pointer; } .ds-media-selector button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--color-ink, #181818); border-bottom-color: currentColor; } .ds-media-selector button:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #181818); } .ds-media-selector button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #be3215); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Contribution Disclosure
components.description: A native expandable contribution with the current source wording.
components.html:
3D 포토카드

SceneView 기반 3D 포토카드와 퀵뷰 구현. Android Profiler 힙 덤프로 SceneView 내부 Bitmap 메모리릭을 추적하고 Composition 종료 시 자원을 명시적으로 해제하도록 개선
components.css: .ds-contribution { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d0d0c8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d0d0c8); color: var(--color-ink, #181818); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-contribution summary { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; min-height: 62px; gap: 24px; padding: 16px 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-contribution summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-contribution h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.45; font-weight: 600; } .ds-contribution svg { flex-shrink: 0; width: 18px; height: 18px; transition: transform 180ms var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)); } .ds-contribution[open] svg { transform: rotate(90deg); } .ds-contribution p { margin: 0; padding: 0 28px 22px 0; color: var(--color-ink-2, #484844); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.85; } .ds-contribution summary:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #c63819); } .ds-contribution summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #be3215); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-contribution svg { transition: none; } }

SSE 트래픽 확인 도구

components.css: .ds-tools { background: #191919; color: var(--color-paper, #f7f7f5); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-tools-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.6fr); gap: 56px; padding: 26px 0; border-top: 1px solid #4d4d48; border-bottom: 1px solid #4d4d48; } .ds-tools-row h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.5; font-weight: 550; } .ds-tools-row p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.85; color: #c5c5bd; max-width: 65ch; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-tools-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; } }

components.css: .ds-chapter { padding: 14px 0; color: var(--color-ink, #181818); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d0d0c8); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-chapter-heading { display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; } .ds-chapter-heading span { color: var(--color-ink-2, #484844); font-family: var(--font-exhibit, 'Uncut Sans', 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.72; } .ds-chapter-heading h4 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.72; } .ds-chapter-heading a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: inherit; text-underline-offset: .22em; text-decoration-color: var(--color-rule-strong, #9a9a91); } .ds-chapter-heading a:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #c63819); } .ds-chapter-heading a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus, #be3215); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-chapter-heading { gap: 20px; } }

components.name: Side Project Row
components.description: An open Duckie row using its real period and approved summary.
components.html:
2022.04 - 2023.12

Duckie

팬덤 퀴즈 앱을 함께 개발해 Play Store에 출시했습니다.

  • 기능 모듈 사이의 화면 이동에서 발생한 의존 문제를 Navigator 인터페이스와 Hilt 주입으로 해결
  • Jetpack Compose 기반 퀴즈 출제, 풀이와 랭킹 기능 개발
  • Play Store 배포와 QA 이슈 관리
components.css: .ds-side-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 72px; padding: 28px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-rule, #d0d0c8); color: var(--color-ink, #181818); font-family: var(--font-body, 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); } .ds-side-meta { grid-row: 1 / 3; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; color: var(--color-ink-2, #484844); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.72; } .ds-side-meta h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-exhibit, 'Uncut Sans', 'Wanted Sans', sans-serif); color: var(--color-ink, #181818); font-size: 34px; font-weight: 550; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-side-row p, .ds-side-row ul { margin: 0; color: var(--color-ink-2, #484844); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.8; } .ds-side-row ul { margin-top: 14px; padding-left: 18px; } @media (max-width: 760px) { .ds-side-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 14px; } .ds-side-meta { grid-row: auto; } .ds-side-row ul { margin-top: 0; } }

narrative.overview:
The personal editorial portfolio gives Ricky Choi's name, actual product screens and verified responsibilities the largest visual roles. Uncut Sans lettering, Wanted Sans Korean text, paper surfaces and one red-orange accent define the current local implementation. Thin rules separate contributions, dates and destinations without enclosing each item in a card.

The user rejected the earlier generic headline, conventional typography and pastel exhibition. This record replaces that discarded world. It describes the October 6, 2026 local replacement and remains provisional until the user reviews it. PRODUCT.md and docs/portfolio/content.md continue to govern identity, claims and approved assets.
keyCharacteristics: Named identity and approved product screens in an asymmetric opening.
Open project spreads with intact portrait media and native contribution disclosures.
Separate model-development and Android responsibilities in the AI case.
Dark tools reading section, compact career dates and flat secondary-work rows.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Use red-orange for the identity mark, selected link feedback and keyboard focus. Keep project reading surfaces neutral.

rules.name: The Reading Voice Rule
rules.body: Keep Korean explanations in Wanted Sans. Use Uncut Sans for the English identity, product names and compact project metadata.

rules.name: The Flat Reading Rule
rules.body: Keep reading rows and controls flat. Reserve the existing screen shadow for the opening Vuddy composition.

dos: Do preserve complete approved images, their captions and direct original-image links.
Do keep the two AI responsibility groups separate and identify the masked images as mockups.
Do retain native disclosures, visible keyboard focus and explicit media selection.
Do inspect current desktop and mobile renders after a visual change and apply plain-language.md before adding copy.
donts: Don't restore the generic engineer headline, pastel exhibition walls or centered three-screen showcase.
Don't crop case images to fill a fixed vacant stage or replace approved screens with invented artwork.
Don't add rounded or elevated shells around ordinary reading rows.
Don't infer user aesthetic approval or deployment from a technical check or independent local-review verdict.
